subject: The secret mistake 90% of users make every race
preview_text: Power users never look at the confidence score first. They check this one thing instead. It changes everything.
body_paragraphs: I watched a guy at Cheltenham last week. He was glued to his phone, checking Predictify before every race. He was winning. Not just picking winners, but finding the value. I finally asked him his secret. He said, 'Everyone looks at the AI's top pick. That's the rookie move.'

The real edge isn't just seeing which horse the AI likes. It's seeing WHY, and then finding where the market has it wrong. The pros use the AI's deep analysis as a starting point, not the finish line. They look for the horse where our data screams 'undervalued'—the one with the surging jockey form and perfect distance rating that the morning line odds completely ignore. That's where the real money is.

Here's the hack: Stop opening a race and looking at the confidence score. Open the full racecard analysis first. Scroll past the top pick. Find the horse with the glaring green checkmarks in 'Jockey/Trainer Combo' and 'Track Condition Match' but longer odds. That's your golden ticket. The AI gives you the 'why,' the market gives you the price. Your job is to connect them.

Open the app right now. Pick any race today. Find that undervalued runner with the perfect profile the crowd missed. That's how you move from punter to pro. P.S. The sharpest users run this scan across UK, US, and AUS races in under 2 minutes. They've turned efficiency into an edge.
